_comment: Facts for the header card. Edit this, not the SVG. scripts/profile-cards.mjs renders assets/header-{dark,light}.svg from it nightly and on every push to this file. The numbers trace to job-hunt/resume/bullets.yaml; keep them identical so the header, the resume and LinkedIn never disagree. Updated 2026-10-17: added '2 npm packages' (shadowjoin 0.3.2 and concord-engine 0.3.1, both also listed in the MCP registry, each checked against the published tarball). The ERP req/day stat was dropped to make room; it is still on the resume. NO DOWNLOAD COUNT, deliberately and after checking: npm reports 747 for shadowjoin over the last month, of which 705 landed on publish day and 42 the day after, with zeros on every other day — that is registry propagation, not use. concord-engine has no download data at all yet. A usage number belongs here only when it reflects people choosing the package, and the API will say so plainly when that happens. x positions are hand-placed; respace the whole row if a label changes length.
